name: GCSE Biology (AQA 8461) — separate science, Foundation and Higher tier

selected_options.tiers_built: Both Foundation and Higher, consistent with Mathematics and Combined Science
selected_options.pathway_note: This is the separate-science route (full Biology GCSE), distinct from the Biology content folded into Combined Science: Trilogy -- same core topic areas but with significantly more depth (e.g. the brain, the eye, plant hormones, monoclonal antibodies, DNA structure detail) and 10 required practicals rather than a shared subset.

material_vintage: AQA GCSE Biology (8461) specification (first teaching 2016, current and live). Every subject-content code 4.1.1.1-4.7.5.4, the 10 required practicals (practical assessment section), Working scientifically WS1-WS4 (section 3) and the Mathematical requirements items (section 7) were itemised on 2026-09-19 from AQA's own specification pages and PDF. Stage test scenarios are original questions written in the style of AQA papers, not real past-paper items.
level_source: RQF Level 2 (GCSE, full grade range 1-9 / Foundation+Higher tiers covered), per Ofqual's Register of Regulated Qualifications listing for this specification
